units.source_text: 虽说是告别赛的第三年，但那是正月的事，

en.t: Although it was said to be the third year since the farewell match, that was a matter of the New Year,

units.source_text: 实际上只过了一年多，名人的内弟高桥四段在镰仓私邸教授起围棋来。

en.t: in fact only a little over a year had passed, and the Master's younger brother-in-law, Takahashi Fourth Dan, began teaching go at his private residence in Kamakura.

units.source_text: 开学那天，名人带着弟子前田六段和村岛五段出席了。

en.t: On the opening day, the Master attended with his disciples Maeda Sixth Dan and Murashima Fifth Dan.
This was the seventh day of the first month.

units.source_text: 我又同阔别许久的名人相会了。

en.t: I met the Master again after a long separation.
